tags: Dark Metal: A fast, menacing instrumental metal track built for a high-speed race. A screaming high-gain lead guitar carries a catchy, sinister main melody right up front, full of pinch-harmonic squeals and whammy dives. Behind it, a rhythm guitar drives tight thrash-metal gallops, then drops out into long, ominous pauses that let the lead breathe. Fast thrash drums with skank beats and crashing cymbals push the energy forward, while a dark analog synth pad hums low in the background like a distant storm. Minor key, aggressive and relentless, built around a memorable hook that keeps coming back.

Racing Metal: An intense instrumental theme in the spirit of late-90s arcade racing games, but darker and heavier. The star is a shrieking lead guitar playing a sticky, singable riff that sounds like an anthem, with squealing harmonics at the end of each phrase. A second guitar answers with galloping thrash rhythm parts and sudden silences. Pounding fast drums keep the speed, and a brooding synth pad sits far behind everything, adding dread. Every section returns to the main hook.
